top_signals.title: Atlas Merchant Invests in Edge Focus
top_signals.summary: Bob Diamond, CEO of Atlas Merchant Capital & Elliott Lorenz, Co-Founder & CEO of Edge Focus discuss the new minority investment. They also discussed the role of private credit in consumer debt.   (Source: Bloomberg)
